transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?
I’ve barely had an appetite the last few weeks. Even food I usually like after a shift just sits there—I make myself eat a few bites, but that’s about it.
Aside from your appetite, how has your mood been over the past few weeks?
Most days, I just feel kind of heavy and flat. Even when I’m at home with my family or in the break room at work, it’s like I’m there, but not really present.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in activities and hobbies that you normally enjoy?
Yeah. I used to look forward to my morning runs, playing guitar, cooking dinner—but lately I keep skipping all of it. It just feels like chores I can’t really make myself care about.
Have you ever had times in your life where you felt unusually energized, wired, or like your thoughts were racing, even with very little sleep?
No, I don’t think so. I can’t remember having periods where I felt especially wired or like I needed hardly any sleep.
Have you ever gone through a period like this before in your life, or is this the first time?
I’m not really sure. I can’t think of another time that was like this.
Did anything particularly stressful happen or did you experience any major life changes around the time these feelings started?
Yeah. About three weeks ago, the casino reorganized security and changed my assignments. That’s around when this started.
How has your sleep been over the past few weeks?
I’m not sure exactly. I haven’t really been keeping track of my sleep lately.
How have your energy levels been over the past few weeks?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid much attention to my energy levels lately.
Have you been feeling down on yourself, worthless, or having excessive feelings of guilt lately?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed feeling especially guilty or worthless lately.
Have you had any trouble concentrating, focusing, or making decisions recently?
Yeah. At work, when I’m watching the CCTV feeds or writing incident reports, my mind kind of drifts. I end up rereading things over and over, and I’ve made mistakes I normally wouldn’t make.
Have you had any thoughts of wanting to give up, hurting yourself, or that life isn't worth living?
I’m not planning to hurt myself. But sometimes I think… maybe it wouldn’t be so bad if I just didn’t wake up and didn’t have to keep pushing through everything.
